goal_name: Ensure AI system design and development

subgoals.objective_name: AI systems shall be designed and developed according to defined requirements.
subgoals.goal_name: Design AI systems and Develop AI systems according to defined requirements

subgoals.control_name: AI systems shall be designed and developed according to defined requirements.

OntoSecAI.name: Design hardware with fault-tolerant architectures, employ error-correcting codes (ECC), and conduct regular fault injection testing to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities that could be exploited through hardware fault injection.

actions.name: System Mapping
actions.description: System mapping encompasses the techniques to identify the organization's systems, how they are configured and decomposed into subsystems and components, how they are dependent on one another, and where they are physically located.
actions.reason: System mapping helps identify and decompose system components during design, ensuring structured and secure architecture.

actions.name: Input Validation
actions.description: Filter malicious inputs to avoid model poisoning.
actions.reason: Input validation mitigates model poisoning risks during AI system design by filtering malicious inputs.

actions.name: Use-Case Specific Training
actions.description: Create separate models for different usecases.
actions.reason: Use-case specific training ensures AI models are tailored to secure and accurate operational requirements.

actions.name: Deploy advanced verification mechanisms
actions.description: Deploy advanced content verification mechanisms, such as digital signatures and trusted identity frameworks, to ensure the authenticity of content and identities, preventing AI systems from making decisions based on spoofed or false data.
actions.reason: Advanced verification mechanisms prevent AI systems from using spoofed data, ensuring decision integrity.

actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: System vulnerability assessment identifies design flaws and risks in the AI system's architecture.

actions.name: Domain Logic Validation
actions.description: Validation of variable state in the context of the domain application.
actions.reason: Validates domain logic to ensure AI systems adhere to defined functional and operational requirements.

actions.name: Validate ML Model
actions.description: Validate that machine learning models perform as intended by testing for backdoor triggers or adversarial bias. Monitor model for concept drift and training data drift, which may indicate data tampering and poisoning.
actions.reason: Validates ML models for backdoor triggers and adversarial bias, ensuring they meet defined performance and security requirements.

actions.name: Process Code Segment Verification
actions.description: Comparing the "text" or "code" memory segments to a source of truth.
actions.reason: Verifies process code segments against a source of truth, ensuring implementation aligns with defined system specifications.

actions.name: Legitimacy Verification
actions.description: Ensure data legitimacy throughout training stages.
actions.reason: Ensures data legitimacy throughout training stages, preventing model poisoning and ensuring training data compliance with requirements.

actions.name: Code Signing
actions.description: Enforce binary and application integrity with digital signature verification to prevent untrusted code from executing. Adversaries can embed malicious code in ML software, models and Library. Enforcement of code signing can prevent the compromise of the machine learning supply chain and prevent execution of malicious code.
actions.reason: Enforces code signing for binaries, preventing untrusted code execution in AI systems.

actions.name: Application Performance Monitoring
actions.description: Monitoring the count and duration of the application or program cycle.

actions.name: Monitoring and auditing
actions.description: Regularly monitoring and auditing the model’s use can help detect and prevent theft by detecting when an attacker is attempting to access or steal the model.

actions.description: Sign models and code, apply anomaly detection, and monitor.
actions.reason: Anomaly detection in AI systems helps identify deviations from normal behavior, which is essential for monitoring security and performance.

actions.name: Application Exception Monitoring
actions.description: Monitoring the failures of system counters and timers.
actions.reason: Application Exception Monitoring directly supports detecting failures or attacks on AI systems by tracking exceptions and errors.
